flows.notes: Detection is read against sources this flow writes, on purpose: the vendors of a registered repository are its own content, and asserting them would grade the fixture. The probe file carries one SDK import, two URLs of one vendor (one of them on a subdomain), and four hosts the doc says are never counted — localhost, `example.com`, a private suffix and a schema namespace — so the positive and the negative halves are read from one listing.
